feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that the horizontal asymptote of the graph is $y=1.$ This means that $k=1$ and we can re-write our function as

$$
y=\frac{a}{x}+1.
$$

Also, we are given that the point $(1,3.5)$ lies on the graph. Substituting its coordinates into the equation above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\frac{a}{x}+1 \\ 3.5 & =\frac{a}{1}+1 \\ 3.5 & =a+1 \\ a & =2.5.\end{aligned}
$$
